description: This file handles the deletion of user roles within the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves role IDs from request parameters, gets corresponding role instances, deletes the specified role, and redirects to the roles list page.

classes.name: Vtiger_Role
classes.description: Represents a user role in vtiger CRM, providing methods to retrieve and delete roles.

methods.name: getInstanceById
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of Vtiger_Role corresponding to a given role ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the role instance, optionally using a target role for context.
